question: Which org is this: name, type, instance, sandbox or production?

steps.name: org
steps.soql: SELECT Id, Name, OrganizationType, InstanceName, IsSandbox, TrialExpirationDate, NamespacePrefix, LanguageLocaleKey, TimeZoneSidKey FROM Organization LIMIT 1

verdicts.say: This is a sandbox: {= org.records[0].Name} on {= org.records[0].InstanceName}.
This is PRODUCTION: {= org.records[0].Name} on {= org.records[0].InstanceName}.

traps: The platform release is not here; read it from /services/data on the instance.
